messages:
alyssa_dev: FYI customer 'BrightEdge' escalated — invoice shows ~120k tokens more than their dashboard. They forwarded invoice PDF and a snapshot of the dashboard.

alyssa_dev: this smells like the event ingestion lag from last night (region eu-west-1). I saw a backlog in the eventstore around 02:10 UTC. Could be a replay/billing double-count or missed dedupe.

mike_sre: on it. pulling logs and the replay metadata. any tenant-id or example request IDs?

alyssa_dev: tenant=brightedge-prod. Sample request id: req_0a9c3f. Customer says discrepancy spans 2025-11-11 00:00 to 2025-11-11 05:00 UTC.

jordan_oncall: I can confirm eventstore had a transient write timeout at 02:07-02:12 and the ingestion workers retried. We have retry semantics that can cause duplicate events if dedupe index was temporarily unavailable.

ops_bot: incident created: INC-2025-1198 - "eventstore-write-timeout -> ingestion-retries" assigned to #eng-sre.

mike_sre: steps I'm doing: 1) verify replay wasn't run twice for this tenant; 2) check dedupe index hits; 3) run local replay in dry-run mode for the tenant window.

mike_sre: running dry-run now. output snippet: ```
replay-run --tenant brightedge-prod --from 2025-11-11T00:00Z --to 2025-11-11T05:00Z --mode dry
SUMMARY: events_found=47,120  dedupe_candidates=512  expected_tokens=1,024,188
```

sara_billing: if dry-run tokens ~= invoice delta then we can explain, but customer wants a fix (credit or corrected invoice). Keep me updated.

mike_sre: dry-run matches approx 118k tokens delta compared to dashboard export (which had about 906k). Looks like duplicates from retried ingests accounted for the extra tokens.

alyssa_dev: can we produce a reconciliation table for the customer showing original events vs deduped count and the final token delta? They'll want a CSV.

mike_sre: yes. I'll run full replay with dedupe and output CSV. Command: ```
replay-run --tenant brightedge-prod --from 2025-11-11T00:00Z --to 2025-11-11T05:00Z --dedupe true --output csv --run-id replay-1845001234
```

jordan_oncall: note: make sure to use the reconciler flag that ignores ephemeral retry-ids: --ignore-retry-token. We had a bug last month where replay dedupe missed those.

mike_sre: good catch. re-running with flag.``` 
replay-run --tenant brightedge-prod --from 2025-11-11T00:00Z --to 2025-11-11T05:00Z --dedupe true --ignore-retry-token --output csv --run-id replay-1845001234
```

ops_bot: replay job queued: replay-1845001234 (ETA ~18m) on replayer-2 (eu-west-1).

sara_billing: once you have the CSV attach to the support ticket and draft a one-paragraph explanation and recommended remediation (credit vs invoice adjustment). I'll handle the customer comms.

mike_sre: replay finished. results snippet: ```
REPLAY_ID: replay-1845001234
events_scanned=47,120
unique_events_after_dedupe=46,503
tokens_before_dedupe=1,024,188
tokens_after_dedupe=906,032
token_delta=118,156
```

mike_sre: attaching reconciler CSV to the ticket now. Also logged run metadata to /var/log/replays/replay-1845001234.log and linked to INC-2025-1198.

alyssa_dev: thanks. Sara, recommend a pro-rated credit for 118,156 tokens or re-issue invoice? Customer prefers invoice adjustment.

sara_billing: agreed — reissue corrected invoice and apply a note about the reconciliation. I'll coordinate with finance for the credit memo.

jordan_oncall: I'll open a follow-up engineering task to harden dedupe index availability and add a guard in the ingestion worker to better surface when dedupe service is down. Ticket: ENG-6789.

mike_sre: created commit to add defensive checks and a replay-runner alert if dedupe hits >0.5% of scanned events. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/replayer/pull/432

alyssa_dev: customer updated in support thread, they asked for the CSV and a timeline. I posted CIR (chronology) in the ticket: outage window and replay outcome. They appreciated the transparency. :thumbsup:

sara_billing: closing loop — I'll send corrected invoice and copy you all. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

mike_sre: leaving a short postmortem blurb in #postmortems and linking INC-2025-1198 with replay artifacts.

ops_bot: incident INC-2025-1198 status -> resolved (reconciliation completed, invoice adjustment pending).
